newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt food firm Nasr 95/96 profits rise.
newsitem.headline: Egypt food firm Nasr 95/96 profits rise.

text.p: Egypt's Nasr Dehydrated and Agricultural Products net after-tax profits rose in 1995/6 to 5.12 million pounds ($1.51 million) from 4.61 million in 1994/5, results published on Sunday showed.
The financial year ends on June 30.

The privatised firm will distribute 3.596 million pounds of the profit to shareholders. The company has approximately 800,000 shares and the profit figure would be equivalent to about 4.5 pounds for each share.
In September, the state sold to the private sector 59.4 percent, or 475,230 shares, of the company.

The results were different from figures given earlier this year by corporate sources that said the firm's 95/96 after-tax profits had risen to 3.099 million pounds from 1.960 million a year earlier. There was no explanation for the difference.
